params.body:
## What changed for the dealer

- The **Merk** select in "Zoek gemiddelde verkoopprijs eindklant" opened on a blank option labelled "(0)", under "Alle (n)". It now opens on "Alle (n)", and every select in the modal has exactly one empty-valued option, "Alle", first and selected.
- The result footer is a small block: "Gemiddelde verkoopprijs" quietly above, the amount alone on its line in large tabular figures rounded to the euro (`€ 23.638`, exact value in the title), and one quiet line under it: "185 verkochte wagens in de laatste 12 maanden, van € 1.750 tot € 90.000" (exact bounds in the title).

## Why

`Enumeration::getManufacturers()` prepends an empty pair (`with_empty_pair`). Since PR 374 counted every option, that pair became a real `<option value="">(0)</option>` next to the view's own `<option value="">Alle (n)</option>`; two options with the same empty value, and the browser kept the second as the selection. Transmission, fuel and category already went through `withoutEmpty()`; make did not. `options()` now strips the empty pair itself, for every select.

The calculation receives the same empty string for "Alle" as before; the pinned calculation tests from PR 374 are unchanged and green (the exact figures are still in the markup, in the `title` attributes).

## Tests

- `AveragePriceSearchTest::test_every_select_starts_on_all_and_has_no_blank_option`: for each of the six selects, before and after choosing a make and a category, the first option is "Alle (", it carries the empty value, no other option has an empty value, and no option has an empty label. Fails on origin/main ("make: a second option with an empty value would take the selection").
- `AveragePriceSearchTest::test_the_result_shows_the_rounded_amount_with_the_exact_figure_in_the_title`.
- `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='Average|Price|HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews'`: OK (123 tests, 1348 assertions).

Finding (opgelost): `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-gemiddelde-prijs-merk-startte-leeg.md`. Translations added in nl/en/fr/de/es (`avg_from_to`, `sold_price_average`, `bid_average`; `avg_between` was nl-only).

Screenshots (1440 with the Merk list expanded, 390): `.playwright-mcp/avgprice-blank/before-1440-merk-open.png`, `after-1440-merk-open.png`, `after-390.png`.
params.title: The average-price search starts on 'Alle', not on a blank option
